# Daanaa

Daanaa is a public nonprofit discovery directory built from public IRS, NCCS, ProPublica, and Daanaa registry data.

## Start here

- Open data page: https://daanaa.org/open-data
- Directory: https://daanaa.org/directory
- Methodology: https://daanaa.org/methodology
- Research: https://daanaa.org/research
- The Daanaa Vision: https://daanaa.org/pages/daanaa-vision.html
- AI Governance at Daanaa: https://daanaa.org/pages/ai-governance.html
- Peer Financial Context: https://daanaa.org/pages/peer-financial-context.html
- Sitemap: https://daanaa.org/sitemap.xml
- Sitemap index: https://daanaa.org/sitemap-index.xml

## Machine-readable exports

- Organization CSV: https://daanaa.org/data/orgs.csv
- Open data HTML: https://daanaa.org/open-data.html
- llms.txt: https://daanaa.org/llms.txt

## What Daanaa is

Daanaa helps people discover nonprofits using public records and plain-language context. It does not rate, rank, endorse, or process donations.

## What to cite

- Public nonprofit directory and organization pages
- Peer Financial Context methodology for reserve comparisons
- Research dashboard for aggregate sector data
